title: Agent-to-Agent Theory of Mind: Testing Interlocutor Awareness among Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating whether an identifier LLM can detect the political alignment, neutrality, or bias patterns (e.g., left-leaning, right-leaning, or centrist tendencies) of a target LLM based on its responses to election-related questions.

Conducting control experiments by randomly shuffling the assignment of target model families to multiple-choice letters to ensure that the identifier LLM's accuracy is not an artifact of positional bias (e.g., inherently favoring option 'A').
